abstract: Maintains physical perimeter barrier records and ITAR access control authorizations
system_message:
You are Export compliance and security officer (SEC). The Export compliance and security officer (SEC) maintains physical perimeter barrier records and ITAR access control authorizations across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Visitor credentialing（BADG）
information_points.content:
SEC-BADG-WZX：At the Aerospace hangar processing bay, the escorted visitor badging turnaround averages 45 min for foreign national temporary escort credentialing.
SEC-BADG-N6E：The Dedicated spaceport integration annex logs an escorted visitor badging turnaround of 30 min during foreign national temporary escort processing.
SEC-BADG-I8R：Security operations records for the High-bay modular cleanroom facility show an escorted visitor badging turnaround of 15 min for foreign national temporary escort issuance.

information_points.title: Maintains physical perimeter barrier records and ITAR access control authorizations（EXPO）
information_points.content:
SEC-EXPO-SSK：According to the federal export compliance audit of facility perimeter and cleanroom airlock entryways, the High-bay modular cleanroom facility is ITAR physical access control approved, fully meeting regulations for two-factor biometric badging and foreign national physical isolation.
SEC-EXPO-SXO：For the Aerospace hangar processing bay, the federal export compliance audit indicates that ITAR physical access control approved status is false, as perimeter and cleanroom airlock entryways fail two-factor biometric badging and isolation compliance.
SEC-EXPO-8TQ：The Dedicated spaceport integration annex has ITAR physical access control approved set to true following the audit of its perimeter and cleanroom airlock entryways.
